name: Boredom-Busting Bubblegum
desc: Lohen's specialty. Seeing that you were bored, he handed you a few candies and grandly claimed they'd help pass the time. After only a few chews, he suddenly pulled out a mirror and flashed it in front of you, looking entirely too pleased with himself. Oh no — it was a setup all along! Your tongue was already dyed a bright blue-green... So by "help pass the time," he meant his own?

value.text: Revives the selected character and restores 20% of Max HP, then restores an additional 1,500 HP.

customize.name: Mint Bubblegum
customize.desc: A soft, chewy candy featuring a blend of two distinct flavors. With a bit of practice, you can blow impressively massive bubbles! Just watch out — if you push it too far and the bubble pops, you'll end up with a face full of sticky goo!
